notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l004: Менде variant of бенде mortal, not in me. Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/мен/. Also850:l019 and852:l012.
notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l009: Becoming black earth death formula, literal curse in naming blessing.
notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l018: Bakburchun named enemy, no geographic speculation.
notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l024: Repeated age twelve and instruction to go to Talas retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l034: Катык- III grow strong/harden, Yudakhin https://el-sozduk.kg/катык/ retrieved by direct HTTP. Akbaltay gives away all and grows resolute; unusual juxtaposition retained, not silently turned into poverty.
notes.manas-2010:p0850:b001:l040: Sixty stepmothers as printed, not corrected to fifty-nine from sixty wives.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l004: Child Chubak kills other children in fights; not sanitized into mere rough play.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l007: Evil-eye belief is the father’s concern, not a medical claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l012: Six black bulls ritually slaughtered each morning according to the preceding routine; no added ritual details.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l014: Күйү means consumed/lost property, not necessarily literal fire; defective verb ending preserved raw.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l022: Арзан cheap/common negated as praise, not a monetary price for the child.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l029: Атагын көргөн visibly means seeing renown; unusual sensory pairing retained rather than changing to heard.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l034: Калыйпа caliph/spiritual leader; letter rendered literally, possible credential function unasserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l035: Correction after individual PDF-image/context review on2026-09-14. Primary Yudakhin кол exact он эки бирге кол берген means follower of twelve ishans/spiritual masters; бирге is pir+dative, not together. Same construction with seven at753 retained source numeral. English corrects direction of allegiance; no source edit. Reviewed /tmp/manas-pir-review851.png.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l036: Зайыппуруш Illustrious Champion, same edition glossary1842:l016–019 as earlier568; no wife-related etymology.
notes.manas-2010:p0851:b001:l038: Precious deed/experience seen; dream context follows, exact syntax provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l002: God troubling/testing the dreamer; trial broadly renders убара.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l008: Narrated divine speech contains anti-unbeliever battle mission; translated as epic voice, not endorsement or present-day instruction.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l011: Six lions and Manas as the youngest are explicit; no unsupported list of names.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l013: God makes Chubak an equal companion to Manas; not that Manas creates him.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l022: Ат бороюн сыдыруу riding far and wide, source glossary1834:l022; no literal stripping of a horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l024: Арлап visit/travel across each part, not a camel-related verb.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l026: Сайыш spear combat retained, not generic fighting alone.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l032: Narrator identifies the dream visitor as Khizir, not a separate historical person.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l038: The peoples do not yet know Chubak despite earlier renown; apparent formulaic tension preserved.
notes.manas-2010:p0852:b001:l042: Мекенин here is the genitive of Mecca, in the context of his studies; not generic abandonment of his homeland.
